description: Procedural character roster. Every mesh is generated by @/characters/mesh and every texture is either synthesised by @/characters/roster or a CC0 Poly Haven map listed in cc0Textures. No third-party character asset is used, downloaded or referenced anywhere in this roster.

atlas.layout: row 0 = v 0; textures bind with flipY=false
atlas.packing: albedo RGB + crowd tint mask in A; ORM = AO(R)/roughness(G)/metalness(B)

mat.metal.shutter.painted.author: Dario Barresi, Rico Cilliers, Charlotte Baglioni
